answer_2.quote: We adopt the automatic evaluation metrics following existing works of the story visualization task and report results using the evaluation script provided in prior work. Character F1 score measures the percentages of characters obtained from the generated images that exactly appear in the story inputs. Frame Accuracy (Exact Match) metric measures whether all characters in a story are present in the corresponding images... Frechet Inception Distance (FID) summarizes how similar two groups are... Video Captioning Accuracy conducts back translation (i.e., image-to-text generation) ... It reports BLEU scores between the predicted caption and the ground truths... a Retrieval-based metric ... Hierarchical DAMSM is used to compute cosine similarity and rank results.

answer_4.quote: We hire in total 9 Amazon Mechanical Turkers ... In total, we collect 218 sets of valid annotations story visualization results. By comparing models provided with the same input story, we ask annotators to rank the resulting image sequences. They rank the visualizations on a scale of 1 to 3, with 3 indicating the best ... We assess Visual Quality (overall image quality) and Character Preservation (occurrences of characters).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank each model's generated image sequence on a scale of 1 to 3, focusing on visual quality and character preservation.
